labels.premise: Friday evening, above the Chicago River, Aarna and Mukund are getting ready to celebrate her gallery acceptance. Then the exhibition is canceled. Dinner changes, but they still have to eat, walk home, and live beside each other. By Saturday night, the conversation has carried them farther than either expected.
labels.aarnaDescription: Her workroom is full of paintings; tonight she was meant to celebrate them. She needs someone to stay with the disappointment before making another plan.
labels.mukundDescription: He comes home with a book and a dinner reservation. Finding a solution is one way he knows to care. Waiting without one is harder.
labels.openingDescription: Friday after work. A celebration interrupted.
